voice.gerald.brief.text: My clients trust me with their money. I’d like a website that makes them feel… calm. Nothing should move. Nothing should sparkle. Last year someone sent me an emoji and I had to lie down.

voice.gerald.happy-1.text: This is… orderly. I may frame it. Next to my other framed spreadsheet.

voice.gerald.happy-2.text: Balanced, like a good ledger. I’m experiencing what young people call “a vibe”.

voice.gerald.happy-3.text: My clients will trust this. I trust this. I’m emailing my mother.

voice.gerald.meh-1.text: It’s fine. Like a tie that’s slightly too wide. I’ll live.

voice.gerald.meh-2.text: It mostly adds up. There’s a rounding error somewhere and it’s bothering me.

voice.gerald.meltdown-1.text: Why is it SPARKLING? My glasses just fogged up.

voice.gerald.meltdown-2.text: This website owes me an apology and possibly back taxes.

voice.gerald.meltdown-3.text: I need a quiet room, a pencil and a glass of room-temperature water.

voice.gerald.times-up.text: Late? I have never filed anything late in thirty-one years.

voice.gerald.hurry.text: Thirty seconds. I’m getting my calculator out.

voice.gerald.perfect-palette.text: Navy. The colour of reliable socks. Go on.

voice.gerald.deal-breaker-palette.text: Is my screen broken or is this… pink?

voice.gerald.perfect-heading.text: A serif! Finally, a font with a pension plan.

voice.gerald.deal-breaker-heading.text: That font looks like it would bounce a cheque.

voice.gerald.perfect-style.text: Neat edges. Tidy borders. I feel audited in a good way.

voice.gerald.decoy-picture.text: Who chose this picture? It isn’t itemised.

voice.gerald.deal-breaker-decoration.text: Is something… celebrating? Make it stop.

voice.gerald.must-have-added.text: Ah, Margaret’s review. She’s very thorough.

voice.gerald.rule-nav-first.text: Where’s the menu? I’m lost on my own website.

voice.gerald.rule-footer-last.text: Why is the footer in the middle? Is the website falling over?

voice.gerald.rule-needs-hero.text: What is this website even for?

voice.gerald.rule-not-too-short.text: Is that it? I’ve seen longer receipts.

voice.gerald.rule-not-too-long.text: I scrolled so long I needed a snack.

voice.gerald.rule-readable-body.text: I need my glasses for this. All of them.

voice.gerald.rule-dont-overdecorate.text: My eyes! Everything is happening at once!

voice.gerald.rule-dont-repeat.text: Didn’t I just see this? And this? And this?

voice.kaia.brief.text: Okay so Leafr matches houseplants with their soulmates. We’re pre-revenue but post-vibes. The site has to feel LOUD. If it looks like a bank, investors fall asleep, and honestly that’s on you.

voice.kaia.happy-1.text: OBSESSED. This is going in the pitch deck. You’re getting equity. (You’re not getting equity.)

voice.kaia.happy-2.text: This slaps. My co-founder is crying. Okay, he cries a lot, but still.

voice.kaia.happy-3.text: Ten out of ten. Disruptive. Iconic. Already posted it.

voice.kaia.meh-1.text: It’s giving… Tuesday. Can it be more Friday?

voice.kaia.meh-2.text: Cute! In a “my aunt made a website” kind of way.

voice.kaia.meltdown-1.text: Is this a PDF from 2009? My investors just unfollowed me.

voice.kaia.meltdown-2.text: This looks like a bank. I’d rather pivot to selling candles.

voice.kaia.meltdown-3.text: I’m literally shaking. Not in a good way. In a “call my therapist” way.

voice.kaia.times-up.text: Missed the deadline? Honestly, very on-brand for a startup.

voice.kaia.hurry.text: Thirty seconds! That’s like three pivots!

voice.kaia.perfect-palette.text: NEON. Yes. My retinas and I approve.

voice.kaia.deal-breaker-palette.text: Navy? Are we filing taxes or changing the world?

voice.kaia.perfect-heading.text: Chunky font energy. Love that for us.

voice.kaia.deal-breaker-heading.text: That font has a mortgage and a minivan.

voice.kaia.perfect-style.text: Thick borders, hard shadows. It looks like it lifts.

voice.kaia.decoy-picture.text: Is that a stock photo? I can smell the stock photo.

voice.kaia.must-have-added.text: A big button! People love clicking big buttons.

voice.kaia.rule-nav-first.text: Where’s the menu? I’m lost on my own website.

voice.rosa.brief.text: My kids say I need a website. Fine. It should feel like my kitchen: warm, cozy, smells like fresh bread. Show the bread! If it looks like a hospital, I’m calling your mother.

voice.rosa.happy-1.text: Bellissimo! You’re too skinny. Sit, I’m bringing biscotti.

voice.rosa.happy-2.text: It smells like bread. I don’t know how, but it smells like bread.

voice.rosa.happy-3.text: My nonna would approve, and she approved of nothing.

voice.rosa.meh-1.text: Is nice. A little like store-bought bread. Edible, but I notice.

voice.rosa.meh-2.text: It’s okay. Like soup with no salt. I see you tried.

voice.rosa.meh-3.text: Good, but where is the bread? People come for the bread!

voice.rosa.meltdown-1.text: Madonna mia, why is it so DARK? Who died? Open a window!

voice.rosa.meltdown-2.text: This looks like a nightclub. I close at six!

voice.rosa.meltdown-3.text: I’m calling your mother. Right now. What’s her number?

voice.rosa.times-up.text: Late? My dough rises faster than you work!

voice.rosa.hurry.text: Hurry, the cornetti are getting cold!

voice.rosa.perfect-palette.text: Warm, like my oven. Now we’re cooking.

voice.rosa.deal-breaker-palette.text: Why is it so cold? Put a sweater on this website.

voice.rosa.perfect-heading.text: Ooh, curly letters. Like my icing!

voice.rosa.deal-breaker-heading.text: That font looks like it has never eaten a carb.

voice.rosa.perfect-style.text: Soft and round, like a good loaf.

voice.rosa.decoy-picture.text: A skyscraper? Is my bakery a bank now?

voice.rosa.must-have-added.text: Show all the bread. ALL of it.

voice.rosa.rule-nav-first.text: Where’s the menu? I’m lost on my own website.

voice.damien.brief.text: Wilted & Co. sells flowers that have accepted their fate. The site must feel like a candlelit parlour at midnight. Show the bouquets. If I see pastel, I will simply… fade away.

voice.damien.happy-1.text: Exquisitely gloomy. I shed a single tear. It was perfect.

voice.damien.happy-2.text: Like a candle in a dark room. I’ve never felt so seen.

voice.damien.happy-3.text: I would be buried in this website. Respectfully.

voice.damien.meh-1.text: It’s dark, but dark like a car park. Not dark like a poem.

voice.damien.meh-3.text: Fine. It’s the beige of black.

voice.damien.meltdown-1.text: Pink? CONFETTI? I’ve never been so personally attacked by a website.

voice.damien.meltdown-2.text: This is so cheerful my eyeliner is running.

voice.damien.meltdown-3.text: Who invited balloons to my funeral? I mean shop.

voice.damien.times-up.text: Ah. The Deadline. We’ve met before.

voice.damien.hurry.text: Thirty seconds. Time is fleeting. Like petals.

voice.damien.perfect-heading.text: Blackletter. Finally, a font that understands me.

voice.damien.perfect-style.text: Clean, sharp, quiet. Like a well-kept crypt.

voice.damien.perfect-pictures.text: Dried flowers. They’ve accepted their fate. As have I.

voice.damien.decoy-picture.text: Balloons. In my shop. I need to lie down.

voice.damien.deal-breaker-decoration.text: Confetti is just glitter’s annoying cousin.

voice.damien.must-have-added.text: Show the bouquets, in all their withered glory.

voice.damien.rule-nav-first.text: Where’s the menu? I’m lost on my own website.

voice.brenda.brief.text: Breathe in… my clients come to me to slow down. The website should feel like a long exhale: soft, natural, lots of space to list my sessions. Breathe out… and please, no shouting fonts.

voice.brenda.happy-1.text: Ahh. I can feel my shoulders dropping. This website is a hug.

voice.brenda.happy-2.text: Breathe in… breathe out… perfect. Namaste, little website.

voice.brenda.happy-3.text: This is so calm my tea brewed itself.

voice.brenda.meh-1.text: It’s… nice. My breathing is steady, but my aura is beige.

voice.brenda.meh-3.text: I’m calm. Mostly. A little bit of my chakra is frowning.

voice.brenda.meltdown-1.text: Too. Much. Going. On. My chakras are tightening.

voice.brenda.meltdown-2.text: This font is shouting at me. Why is it shouting?

voice.brenda.meltdown-3.text: I need a retreat from this website. A long one.

voice.brenda.times-up.text: Rushing is the enemy of peace. And of good websites.

voice.brenda.perfect-palette.text: Sage green. My plants and I feel safe.

voice.brenda.deal-breaker-palette.text: These colours are yelling. Ask them to use their inside voice.

voice.brenda.perfect-heading.text: Soft, round letters. Like a pillow.

voice.brenda.deal-breaker-heading.text: That font just did a cartwheel in my meditation room.

voice.brenda.perfect-style.text: Rounded corners. No sharp edges in my life, please.

voice.brenda.perfect-pictures.text: Lotus flowers. I’m breathing deeper already.

voice.brenda.decoy-picture.text: A skyscraper? I come here to escape those.

voice.brenda.deal-breaker-decoration.text: Confetti? In this economy? In this aura?

voice.brenda.rule-nav-first.text: Where’s the menu? I’m lost on my own website.

voice.brenda.rule-footer-last.text: Why is the footer in the middle? Is the website falling over?

voice.deadline.1.text: Pencils down. I’ll take it from here.

ui.click.text: Soft rubbery button tap, short, dry, friendly UI click, no reverb

ui.toggle.text: Two-note bip-bop going up, cute toggle switch sound, short

ui.hover-soft.text: Tiny wooden tick, very short and quiet, UI hover

ui.sticker.text: Vinyl sticker slapped onto a card with a little paper peel, playful

ui.roulette.text: Game-show prize wheel ticking, slowing down and stopping, short

ui.pick.text: Bubbly pop, short, bright, satisfying selection sound

ui.rewind.text: Quick cassette tape rewind, cartoon, very short

ui.send.text: Paper airplane whoosh flying away, light and quick

ui.count.text: One bright arcade coin pickup blip, clearly audible, cheerful, very short

ui.start.text: Bright marimba upbeat flourish, three notes rising, game start

build.drop.text: Solid wooden block placed firmly on a wooden table, one clear loud thunk, close-up, dry, satisfying

build.remove.text: Short reverse whoosh, object disappearing, cartoon

build.slide.text: Smooth short slide of a card across a desk

build.snap.text: Plastic building brick snapping into place, small click

mood.up.text: Rising three-note chime, happy, short, glockenspiel

timer.heartbeat.text: Low double heartbeat thump, tense, cartoon

verdict.meh.text: Unimpressed hmm trombone, single descending note, comedic

music.lobby.text: Playful, bouncy instrumental theme for a funny design game title screen. Ukulele, marimba, handclaps, light drums, whistled hook, 100 bpm, cheerful and a little cheeky. Loops cleanly: no intro swell, no ending.

music.build.text: Light, curious puzzle-game background music for focused work. Pizzicato strings, marimba, soft brushed drums, 104 bpm, playful but unobtrusive, sits under speech. Loops cleanly: no intro, no ending.

music.build-fast.text: Urgent, comedic race-against-the-clock game music. Fast pizzicato, ticking woodblock, driving drums, 132 bpm, tense but silly, sits under speech. Loops cleanly: no intro, no ending.

music.end.text: Warm, feel-good closing theme for a game's results screen. Ukulele, glockenspiel, gentle claps, 96 bpm, proud and friendly, like a well-earned coffee break. Loops cleanly: no big ending.

voice.deadline.2.text: Done is better than perfect. Also, done is mandatory.

voice.deadline.4.text: Shipping it as is. Good luck.

voice.deadline.5.text: Your final-final-v3 is now just final.
